answer.reason: The verses state several deeds of Hiram beyond his kingship and alliance: aiding David's house, supplying Solomon's temple timber, and sending ships and gold.

clauses.english: sent messengers, cedar trees, carpenters and masons to David to build him a house
clauses.quote: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons

clauses.english: gave Solomon cedar and fir trees for building the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

clauses.english: sent his shipmen with Solomon's servants to fetch gold from Ophir
clauses.quote: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea

doubts: Huram in 2 Chronicles is taken as the same king of Tyre; those verses were used only as support, not cited.
1KI 9:11-14 (the twenty cities) left out as a minor detail; 2CH 2:13 concerns a craftsman, not Hiram himself.
